# fjordrun_teams (Data Source)

The teams the token can see: all your teams with a personal access token, one with a team API token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fjordrun_teams" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this result.
- `teams` (Attributes List) The teams. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--teams))

<a id="nestedatt--teams"></a>
### Nested Schema for `teams`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `founding_member` (Boolean) Whether it has founding member benefits.
- `id` (String) Team ID.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace.
- `plan` (String) `trial`, `hobby`, `pro` or `enterprise`.
- `role` (String) The caller's role.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe name.
- `status` (String) `active` or `suspended`.
